description: Japan crypto-asset tax: realized income under the NTA total-average or moving-average method (sell/spend/exchange as disposals, fees deductible), verified against the official NTA FAQ examples. $0.05/call. Deterministic, cites primary sources; errors and unverified rules are never billed.

as_of.description: Calculation reference date YYYY-MM-DD (default today); selects the rules version

method.description: One of: total_average, moving_average. Cost method: total_average or moving_average

other_taxable_income_yen.description: Other taxable income in yen (returns incremental income tax as reference)

transactions.description: Crypto transactions list (max 300) - see /catalog input spec

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.
